The most compelling evidence is the definitive presence of the T2-FLAIR mismatch sign ('T2-FLAIR Mismatch Present': 1.0, 'T2-FLAIR Mismatch Score': 0.93), which is a highly specific imaging biomarker for IDH-mutant astrocytomas.
